conventions.inputPerM / outputPerM: USD za 1M tokenu (API list price, standard tier, short context)
conventions.cachedInputPerM: USD za 1M cached/read input tokenu; null = caching neni nabizen nebo cena neoverena
conventions.batchDiscount: nasobitel pro batch API (0.5 = 50 % ceny in i out); null = batch nenabizen nebo neoveren
conventions.contextWindow: max kontext v tokenech; null = neovereno (doplnit z model docs)
conventions.tier: EDITORIAL trida pro ranking (frontier | mid | budget) - kalkulator nesrovnava napric tiery cenou; zarazeni je nase redakce, ne benchmark
conventions.verified: kazda cena overena proti oficialnimu ceniku - dump v calc-test/llm-pricing-dumps/<provider>.txt s datem
conventions.swebenchVerified: SWE-bench Verified skore (% vyreseno), vendor self-reported. JEDNA spolecna metrika kvality pro scatter cena x kvalita (volba: coding/agentic, sedi automation/dev publiku). NULL = vendor toto cislo verejne nepublikuje (NEDOPLNOVAT odhadem ani z agregatoru - jako u history 'gap', honest null > vymyslene cislo).
conventions.qualitySource: URL na vendor zdroj (launch blog / model card), odkud swebenchVerified pochazi. Evidence-first, jako u cen.
conventions.qualityVerified: true = cislo cteno primo z vendor stranky (dump v calc-test/llm-benchmark-dumps/ nebo WebFetch vendor tabulky); false = cislo z vendor blogu pres druhou ruku (stranka za JS/anti-bot zdi, graf necitelny) - design ho zobrazi s nizsi jistotou.
